tools.name: list_stock
tools.description: Read-only, free, no credential needed. List the dedicated mobile proxy rentals ipvolt sells now: country, carrier, length (1 or 30 days), price in US cents and whether each is in stock. It never shows stock counts. While per-GB traffic is on sale it also lists the prepaid GB packs with their prices

tools.name: how_to_buy
tools.description: Read-only, free, no credential needed. Explains how to get a credential for the account tools of this server, how the prepaid balance is added, and where the Terms and the Acceptable Use Policy are. This server cannot create an account, take a payment or issue a credential.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Read-only, free. Show the prepaid ipvolt balance (available and held) of the credential's account and, for an API key, its access level, daily spending limit, what it spent today and what it can still spend today; for an agent token, its permissions and spending cap.

tools.name: list_rentals
tools.description: Read-only, free. List the account's active proxy rentals with their connection details (host, ports, username, password), end time, online state, current IP and whether each can rotate or extend. The connection details are secrets: keep them in the user's own configuration.

tools.name: get_rental
tools.description: Read-only, free. Show one of the account's active rentals with its connection details (host, ports, username, password), end time, online state, current IP and whether it can rotate or extend. The connection details are secrets: keep them in the user's own configuration.

tools.name: rent_proxy
tools.description: SPENDS MONEY from the prepaid ipvolt balance of the credential's account. Rent dedicated mobile proxy devices for 1 or 30 days. Two steps: (1) call without confirm: this only looks up the current price and answers the exact charge and a requestId; nothing is charged. (2) Only after the user approved

tools.name: extend_rental
tools.description: SPENDS MONEY from the prepaid ipvolt balance of the credential's account. Extend one of the account's active rentals by 1 or 30 days. tools.name: rotate_ip
tools.description: CHANGES STATE, costs nothing. Ask for a new IP address on one of the account's rentals. Connections open through the device may drop while it changes. tools.name: list_traffic
tools.description: Read-only, free. Show the account's per-GB traffic: the traffic key's state, GB bought, used and left, the gateway host and ports, the countries the residential and the shared mobile pool have now, and the prepaid packs with their prices. It shows no secret; get_traffic_connection gives a connection

tools.name: buy_traffic_pack
tools.description: SPENDS MONEY from the prepaid ipvolt balance of the credential's account. Buy one prepaid pack of GB for residential IPs and for mobile IPs from a shared pool. Two steps: (1) call without confirm: this only looks up the current price and answers the exact charge and a requestId; nothing is charged.

tools.name: get_traffic_connection
tools.description: Read-only, free. Get one ready connection line for the account's per-GB traffic: host, port, username and the traffic key as password, for the residential or the shared mobile network in one country. The line is a secret: keep it in the user's own configuration. Using it spends the account's GB. Nee
